title.ja: どーなってるの!? 今日から正義の味方だにゃん!
title.en: Wait, What?! I`m a Superhero Now?! Meow!
title.x-jat: Dou Natteru no!? Kyou kara Seigi no Mikata Da Nyan!

1.overview: Ichigo has a date with the most popular guy at school and couldn’t be happier! Little does she know that her life is about to get a lot more complicated.
1.summary:
Ichigo has a date with the most popular guy at school and couldn’t be happier! Little does she know that her life is about to get a lot more complicated.
Source: HIDIVE

title.ja: 本当の友達ってなんですか?

2.overview: Tracking down the other magical girls feels like herding cats, but Ichigo is determined to find them! Will working at Café Mew Mew help her sniff out her allies?
2.summary:
Tracking down the other magical girls feels like herding cats, but Ichigo is determined to find them! Will working at Café Mew Mew help her sniff out her allies?
Source: HIDIVE

title.ja: 奪われた唇!? ミュウプリン参上!
title.en: A Stolen Kiss?! Mew Pudding Is Here!

3.overview: A much-anticipated outing with Aoyama takes a turn for the dangerous when a mysterious new enemy boldly introduces himself to Ichigo.
3.summary:
A much-anticipated outing with Aoyama takes a turn for the dangerous when a mysterious new enemy boldly introduces himself to Ichigo.
Source: HIDIVE

title.ja: 憧れのお姉さま 最後の一人は大スター
title.en: Who Doesn`t Want to Be Her? Our Last Member Is a Huge Star!
title.x-jat: Akogare no Onee-sama: Saigo no Hitori wa Dai Star

4.overview: The Mew Mews found a new member, but getting close to her is no easy feat. They'll need to audition for a musical if they want to get anywhere near the intimidating Zakuro!
4.summary:
The Mew Mews found a new member, but getting close to her is no easy feat. They`ll need to audition for a musical if they want to get anywhere near the intimidating Zakuro!

title.ja: 笑ってみんと! お嬢様の憂鬱
title.en: Smile, Mint! A Fancy Lady, Forlorn

5.overview: Mint is used to getting what she wants, so when a person she respects rejects her offer, she feels a little blue. Fortunately, she has Ichigo and the others to cheer her up!
5.summary:
Mint is used to getting what she wants, so when a person she respects rejects her offer, she feels a little blue. Fortunately, she has Ichigo and the others to cheer her up!

title.ja: 心に響け! 私は私を超えていく
title.en: Hear My Voice! I Will Surpass Myself
title.x-jat: Kokoro ni Hibike! Watashi wa Watashi o Koete Iku

6.overview: Mint is determined to protect Zakuro from Kish, but with the team still missing its final member, keeping the fight away from Zakuro may be a losing battle!
6.summary:
Mint is determined to protect Zakuro from Kish, but with the team still missing its final member, keeping the fight away from Zakuro may be a losing battle!
Source: HIDIVE

title.ja: お別れの桜吹雪
title.en: A Farewell in a Flurry of Petals

7.overview: New players join the game, but are they better or worse than the impish Kish? Meanwhile, news of the Mew Mews has spread, and keeping secrets has never been tougher for them!
7.summary:
New players join the game, but are they better or worse than the impish Kish? Meanwhile, news of the Mew Mews has spread, and keeping secrets has never been tougher for them!

title.ja: 自信を持って クルージングは初恋風味
title.en: Belive in Yourself - Romance on the High Seas
title.x-jat: Jishin o Motte: Cruising wa Hatsukoi Fuumi

8.overview: Lettuce is convinced that the only thing she’s good at is being bad at everything! But a soiree on the high seas may provide Lettuce the opportunity to prove herself wrong.
8.summary:
Lettuce is convinced that the only thing she’s good at is being bad at everything! But a soiree on the high seas may provide Lettuce the opportunity to prove herself wrong.

title.ja: 恋のキューピッド! デートマル秘大作戦!
title.en: Let Cupid`s Arrow Fly! The Super Secret Date Scheme!
title.x-jat: Koi no Cupid! Date Maruhi Daisakusen!

9.overview: Mew Aqua can turn the tide of battle against the Chimera Anima, but finding it won’t be easy. What else isn’t easy to find? Spare time to spend with Aoyama, in Ichigo’s case!
9.summary:

title.ja: にゃんてこった! ドキドキが止まらない?
title.en: Cat Got My Tongue?! A Heart-Pounding Transformation!

10.overview: A dangerous situation of epic proportions threatens thousands of civilians, but where the heck is Ichigo!? It’s a race against time to find her and wipe out the alien threat!
10.summary:
A dangerous situation of epic proportions threatens thousands of civilians, but where the heck is Ichigo!? It’s a race against time to find her and wipe out the alien threat!

title.ja: みんなが待ってる! 走れいちご!
title.en: Everyone`s Waiting for You! Run, Ichigo!

11.overview: Aliens have invaded, but Ichigo is nowhere to be found! Her friends have faith she’ll appear and lend a hand, but will she come to their aid in time?
